title: Straylight Control Plane task packet (v1)
description: A bounded implementation (or patch) assignment written by the coordinator. Claude must not begin implementation without a valid packet bound to the lane's CURRENT base SHA; a packet bound to an old base fails closed. Executable validator: .straylight/lib/validate.mjs#validateTaskPacket.

authority_basis.description: Citable authority for this packet (e.g. 'ADR-050 corridor phase-49p; ADR-049 §10 step 3'). A packet whose authority basis cannot be verified against merged repository artifacts must be escalated, not implemented.

target_branch.description: The lane working branch. The INITIAL packet ESTABLISHES it (the reducer records it as lane.working_branch); every later packet must name the same branch, and it may never be the lane's base branch.

allowed_paths.description: Complete allowed file scope (repo-relative prefixes). Anything outside is out of scope.

forbidden_paths.description: Explicitly forbidden paths (e.g. .loa, .claude, src/straylight, .github/workflows/post-merge.yml). Forbidden wins over allowed.

merge_forbidden.description: Control Plane v1: every packet forbids merging. The validator rejects false.
